svg.title: Detailed method schematic. Native mitochondrial assembly and NCR interpretation with mitovarr
svg.desc: Four schematic panels: input contracts; native de novo assembly; reference-guided local assembly; independent gene annotation, tRNA-Pro rotation and NCR analysis. No experimental measurements are depicted.
